4. Is Aadhaar mandatory for applying PAN? Ans: Yes, Aadhaar is mandatory for all except cases under exempted category. 5. Whether minor can apply for PAN and what are the documents required for
applying for PAN? Ans: Yes. In case of a person being a minor PAN can be applied through RA. In addition
to Aadhaar and photograph of the minor, proof of identity and proof of address of RA is
required for applying. 6. Which address can be selected as address for Communication? Ans: Any of the following address can be selected for communication:
i. Residential Address
ii. Office Address
iii. Representative Assessee Address, if applicable.
